title: Speech of President Arroyo during the Lakas-CMD National Convention, April 2, 2007
text:
Speech of Her Excellency Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo President of the Philippines During the Lakas-CMD National Convention

[Delivered at the Tanghalang Francisco Balagtas, Folk Arts Theater CCP Complex, Roxas Blvd., Pasay City, April 2, 2007]

Maraming salamat. Maraming salamat.

Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

Maraming salamat, Speaker De Venecia, pangulo ng ating partido.

Maraming salamat, Chairman Emeritus, Dating Pangulong Ramos sa iyong mga inspiring words.

Binabati ko rin ang iba’t-ibang mga star-studded officials ng ating lapian: narito ang ating DVP, si Mayor Sonny Belmonte; narito ang ating Secretary General, si Nonoy Libanan; narito ang iba’t-ibang kasapi sa partido na nanggagaling sa ating lapian: nandiyan si Ed Ermita, si Gabby Claudio, si Sonny Alvarez, si Raul Gonzalez; nariyan ang ating Majority Leader Boy Nograles at lahat ng ating mga congressmen; nariyan ang ating senador at susunod na punong-lungsod ng Makati, si Lito Lapid; nariyan si Rico Aumentado at lahat ng mga ating mga gobernador at provincial candidates; nariyan si Jerry Treñas at lahat ng ating mga city mayors at city candidates; nandiyan si Monching Guico at lahat ng ating mga municipal mayors and municipal candidates; at nariyan kayong lahat ang ating mga kasangga at pinagtitibayan ng kalakasan ng Lakas-CMD, magandang tanghali at maraming salamat sa inyong lahat.

Malakas ang pag-asa ng lakas para sa kinabukasan ng bansa at kapakanan ng taumbayan. Ang ating mga senatorial candidates hindi ko pa binati. Mamaya pag-uusapan natin sila isang-isa. Pero sa ngayon pag-uusapan natin ang plataporma. Binalangkas ang plataporma ng lakas upang isulong ang bansa tungo sa higit pang katatagan sa pulitika, kasaganaan sa ekonomiya, kapayapaan at katiwasayan.

Nakatutok ang ating plataporma sa paglikha ng mga magandang trabaho at kita, matatag na presyo, paghatid ng mga biyaya ng malakas na ekonomiya sa bawat isang Pilipino. Ito ay platapormang maka-maralita, maka-kaunlaran, maka-modernisasyon. At sabi nga ni Pangulong Ramos, “ang prinsipyo ng Lakas-CMD ay subsidiarity.” Kaya dito sa ating plataporma, we have moved the nation forward on the strength of our phalanx of our local stalwarts like Vic Magsaysay and Chavit Singson.

Tiwala tayo sa mga opisyal sa ating partido at ng ating koalisyon na tinawag ‘Team Unity’,” na sama-sama tayong magtatrabaho upang mapagpatuloy sa landas ng reporma, social justice at pag-unlad ng ekonomiya. Kayo ang bumubuo ng sentro ng demokrasyang Pilipino, ang demokrasyang Pilipino na laging ipinaglalaban ni joker arroyo. Kayo ang mga nasa frontline ng pagbabago.

Lakas partymates, congratulations! For coming out as the most trusted political party in the country. Congratulations! For being the party perceived to be the most capable of addressing the nation’s concerns, whether the economy or security. We must internalize this distinction and embrace it as a solemn responsibility to pursue the fight for the rightful economic and social deliverance of our countrymen. This challenge is most timely and urgent because at no other time than now in the last decade do we have real opportunity for an economic takeoff.

The grand agenda of the administration — fighting poverty and terror and building peace is the foundation of political victory in the elections. Today, the administration coalition has the most comprehensive, doable and ongoing platform of nation-building that has brought six years of continuous growth to the Philippines on top of a strong campaign for law and order, democracy and human rights. Your numbers, the numbers of Lakas push the momentum of victory for the administration at all levels mula sa senador, sa pangulo, sa senador sa congress, sa probinsya, lungsod, bayan. The campaign has still a long way to go but the air of victory rides on the tide of the optimism of the people.

Lakas is the dominant majority party, and therefore, we have the extraordinary capacity to help forge unity, stability and a united front in support of our country’s progress. In achieving victory and advancing of our country’s goals and visions, let us be in synergy rather than in combat with the five other parties within the ‘team unity’ coalition, as well as with the essential sectors of the national community.

The victory of our unity team coalition in your respective districts and localities is as crucial as your own individual victory to our nation’s stability and the ability to secure the present momentum of growth and progress. And so I ask you, Lakas partymate, let each vote you gather for yourself be a vote for every senatorial candidate of team unity.

Ibig nating mawakas ang gridlock. Ibig nating magpatuloy sa landas ng paglikha ng trabaho, kapital at kapayapaan at seguridad. Gusto nating magtrabaho kasama ng lahat ng mga lapian sa ating koalisyon at kahit na sa labas kung may papasok pa upang ipasulong ang bansa at hindi ipaurong.

We have worked tirelessly to build a modern nation that will one day take its rightful place beside first-world countries.

We hope for the day when enough good jobs are created in the Philippines so that hardworking Filipinos don’t have to go abroad for work. We see a day when going abroad for a job is a career choice, not the only option for work.

You and I, our administration have made the tough but necessary decisions to strengthen our economy. These painful steps are paying off. Now, we have the money — thanks to Ralph Recto — to invest in job creation, new roads, bridges and ports; and thanks also to Ed Angara, more on education and healthcare.

Through strong international alliances, we have forged new partnerships that have helped to create five million new jobs. And we have strengthened our military and security alliances in the region and the world. This has led to major gains for peace in Mindanao, from the Caraga of Butch Pichay to the Sulu of Sultan Kiram, this has led to the isolation and tracking down of known terrorists and a reduction in violent crime.

For the first time in a long time, the government is doing what average Filipino families do, yung mga Filipino families na kinakampiyon ni Tito Sotto, kaya tawag natin tito sa senado. Like the average Filipino families, the government is working to balance the budget and reduce our debt. And rather than borrowing to leave our nation in debt as has happened in the past, our administration is investing in the nation and particularly our young people. Ibig sabihin, ang ating ginagawa — MAS PARA SA KIDZ MO. Bakit ko sinabi yung “MAS PARA SA KIDZ MO.” Paalala ang ating hangarin, paalala rin ang mga pangalan ng ating kandidato.

“MAS PARA SA KIDZ MO” — MAS, M-A-S: M-A for Magsaysay, S for Singson. Kaya yung mas yung dalawang gobernador. PARA, P-A-R-A: P for Pichay, A for Angara, R for Recto, A for Arroyo, sila ay mga mambabatas. Mas para SA, S-A: S is for Sotto, A is for Aquino-Oreta, yung dalawang dating senador. Mas para sa KIDZ, K-I-D-Z: K-I, Kiram; D, Defensor; Z, Zubiri. Yung…so yung si Mike Defensor at Migz Zubiri ay yung mga kabataan, si Kiram naman ay elder statesman ng Sulu. At mas para sa KIDZ MO, MO for Montano, a class of his own.

There is much to do if the nation is to work towards a more just, modern and prosperous nation.

We will work to expand education, as Tessie Aquino-Oreta has been doing and will continue to do. We will work to expand healthcare, as Cesar Montano has pledged to do ever since he came across the poisoned children in Bohol. We will take action to develop a green Philippine agenda to improve our environment, as Migz Zubiri has legislated, and through green Philippines we will beautify and put order in our communities, as Mike Defensor has implemented. And we will do all these by working with you, our local party stalwarts, to see that the benefits of the new economy are spread to every corner of the Philippines and not just Metro Manila.

Much of the stability and harmony. Thank you, thank you. Much of the stability and harmony that we wish to have in society will also depend on how politicians undertake the campaign and endeavor to attain victory with honor and dignity. Let us keep these elections peaceful and credible.

And let us join the call of the church for all candidates to spare the Lenten days of Holy Thursday and Good Friday from political noise. Let us all respect the solemnity of the height of the Lenten season and use it as a time for moral rearmament, healing and solidarity.

Pinagsisikapan nating masiguro ang katatagan ng pulitika at ekonomiya upang mabigyan ng pag-asa at inspirasyon ang milyun-milyong masisipag na Pilipino na karapat-dapat magtamo ng mas magandang kalidad ng buhay. Ang tagumpay nitong layunin ay tagumpay ng lakas.

Ang ating koalisyon ay ‘Team Unity’ — suportahan ang pangkat ng pagkakaisa.

Ang ating partido ay Lakas — palakasin pa natin ang ating samahan upang makamit ang ating pambansang mithiin. Gaya nang sinabi ni President Ramos, “kaya natin ito!” ‘di ba?

Sa inyong lahat, maraming salamat.

Mabuhay ang Lakas!
